verdict.rationale: Better Stack publishes a per-endpoint Uptime API reference with copyable curl request examples, filter variants and paginated JSON responses, plus documented CRUD endpoints and bearer-token auth. That is a static reference with examples you can paste into a terminal. There is no evidence of an interactive in-browser console that runs requests, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console that executes requests in the docs, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Per-endpoint Uptime API reference ("List monitors") with copyable request examples per endpoint
Create monitor POST ... Update monitor PATCH ... Remove monitor DELETE
Simply include an `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` header in your requests.
